raw.details:
SEED Hackathon 2026

The Age of Autonomy

A chance to build something that matters.

Event Overview:

  • Format: Virtual | Free to Participate
  • Event Dates: 10 October  – 9 December 2026
  • Grand Finale: 9 December 2026
  • Team Size: 2–3 Members
  • Cash Prize Pool: ₹2,00,000
  • University Partners: Boston University & GW Engineering

Who Can Participate?

Whether you're a student exploring technology or a professional already working in the field, this is your chance to put your skills to the test!

Eligibility:

  • Final Year & Pre-Final Year Students from BE / BTech / BSc / BCA backgrounds

  • First Year & Second Year Students from ME / MTech / MSc / MCA backgrounds

  • Working Professionals in Technical Roles

What's the Hackathon About?

What happens when AI starts making decisions on its own?

That's the big question behind SEED Hackathon 2026.

Organised in collaboration with Boston University and GW Engineering, this global virtual hackathon brings together curious minds to tackle real-world challenges in AI and automation!

You'll work with your team to turn an idea into a working prototype, learn from industry experts, and showcase your skills on a global platform.

Three Unqiue Challenges:

Choose a challenge that excites you and build a solution that makes a difference.

  • No Screens: Explore smarter ways to interact with technology without traditional screens.

  • Chain of Command: Build AI agents that collaborate and solve problems together.

  • The Kill Switch: Design AI systems that are safer, more accountable, and easier to control.

What's in It for You?

Beyond building something exciting, there's plenty to take away.

₹2,00,000 in Cash Prizes

  • 1st Place: ₹50,000 per team

  • 2nd Place: ₹35,000 per team

  • 3rd Place: ₹15,000 per team

Two winning teams will be selected for each position.

And that's not all!

  • Up to 75% tuition scholarships at partner universities

  • Application fee waivers for placing teams

  • Expert mentorship and hands-on learning

  • Recognition from leading global universities

  • Participation certificates and networking opportunities

Important Dates:

Here's your roadmap from idea to finale.

  • 10 October: Registrations & Abstract Submissions Open
  • 22 November: Abstract Submission Deadline
  • 24 November: Shortlist Announcement
  • 25 November – 2 December: Build Your Prototype
  • 3–7 December: Expert Mentorship
  • 9 December: Grand Finale

Your First Step: Submit an Abstract

Have an idea? Tell us about it!

An abstract is simply a short summary of what you want to build. You don't need a finished product to get started.

Just tell us:

  • The Problem: What are you trying to solve?
  • Your Solution: How do you plan to tackle it?
  • The Impact: Why does your idea matter?

Maximum Length: 1,000 words

Submission Deadline: 22 November 2026

Shortlisted teams will move on to the prototyping phase, where they'll bring their ideas to life with expert support.

Ready to Build the Future?

You bring the ideas. We'll bring the platform, the mentorship, and the opportunity to make them real.

Register, explore the challenges, and submit your abstract here:
https://seedglobal.io/vtddw72os

prizes.others: The 1st place winning team members will receive appreciation letters and exclusive hampers from participating international universities, application fee waivers for these universities, and participation certificates, recognizing their achievement and offering valuable opportunities for their academic journey.

The runner-up team members will receive appreciation letters and exclusive hampers from participating international universities, application fee waivers for these universities, and participation certificates, celebrating their efforts and providing valuable opportunities for further academic growth.

The second runner-up team members will receive recognition and opportunities, along with appreciation letters and exclusive hampers from participating international universities, application fee waivers, and participation certificates, honoring their achievement and supporting their academic journey.
